d: Jharkhand samet deshbhar men dipotsav ki dhum dekhne ko mil rahi hai. dipavli ke avsar par vibhinn sthanon par kali puja pandalon ka udghatan kiya gaya, jahan shraddhaluon ki bhir umar rahi hai. khas aur aam sabhi log sukh, samriddhi aur khushhali ki mangalkamna kar rahe hain. vahin, jharkhand men vishesh gahan punrikshan yani esaaaeeaar ki prakriya puri karne vala pashchimi sinhbhum rajy ka pahla jila ban gaya hai. jile men notis jari karne aur sunvaee se jure shat-pratishat mamlon ka nishpadan kar liya gaya hai. idhar, devghar jile ke madhupur men mantri haphijul hasan ne teees vikas…
